description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC convention called GroupByApiRootConvention, which implements IControllerModelConvention to assign an API version group name based on the route attribute of a controller.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: A convention class implementing IControllerModelConvention to set API version grouping based on the route attribute.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Sets the group name for API explorer based on the route attribute's template of the controller.
